component.name: SpaceWindow
component.summary: See where your disk space goes
Découvrez où va votre espace disque

description.p: SpaceWindow shows a drive or a folder as a map of boxes, each as big as the space it takes, folders holding their files and folders: what fills the disk stands out at a glance. It is a modern take on SpaceMonger 1.4.0 by Sean Werkema.

ul.li: Scans on every processor core, with a live map while it runs
Reloads in a moment: only the folders that changed are listed again
A treemap and two pie charts; zoom in and out, go back and forward
Open a file, show it in the file manager, or move it to the trash, from the map
Light, dark and colour themes, and theme files of your own

description.p: SpaceWindow montre un disque ou un dossier comme une carte de boîtes, chacune aussi grande que l'espace qu'elle occupe : ce qui remplit le disque saute aux yeux. C'est une version moderne de SpaceMonger 1.4.0 de Sean Werkema.
SpaceWindow runs on Linux, with everything the Windows version has: the treemap and pie charts, the background animations, themes, reloads of only what changed, and the trash.
The first release, for Windows; this version also builds and runs on Linux.
